answer: One fake identity costs 450 POA locked in a vault for 130 days, and the vault releases nothing until ten paid jobs clear, so a farm cannot split one stake across a thousand keys. A raven check lands with no warning, one live task due in 20 minutes, and a missed check freezes the bond. Three auditors drawn by lot replay one job a month against the public record, and each verified job earns a yarrow mark only the paying client can stamp. A forged mark burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
